question: Which bowler has the lowest bowling average per wicket taken?
sql:
WITH bowler_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.bowler,
        COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) as runs_conceded
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND b.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
        AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.bowler
),
bowler_wickets AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.bowler,
        COUNT(wt.match_id) as wickets_taken
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN wicket_taken wt ON bb.match_id = wt.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = wt.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = wt.ball_id 
        AND bb.innings_no = wt.innings_no
    WHERE bb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
)
SELECT 
    br.bowler,
    p.player_name,
    br.runs_conceded,
    bw.wickets_taken,
    CASE WHEN bw.wickets_taken > 0 THEN 1.0 * br.runs_conceded / bw.wickets_taken ELSE NULL END as bowling_average
FROM bowler_runs br
JOIN bowler_wickets bw ON br.bowler = bw.bowler
JOIN player p ON br.bowler = p.player_id
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 5

```sql
WITH bowler_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.bowler,
        COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) as runs_conceded
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND b.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
        AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.bowler
),
bowler_wickets AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.bowler,
        COUNT(wt.match_id) as wickets_taken
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN wicket_taken wt ON bb.match_id = wt.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = wt.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = wt.ball_id 
        AND bb.innings_no = wt.innings_no
    WHERE bb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
)
SELECT 
    br.bowler,
    p.player_name,
    br.runs_conceded,
    bw.wickets_taken,
    CASE WHEN bw.wickets_taken > 0 THEN 1.0 * br.runs_conceded / bw.wickets_taken ELSE NULL END as bowling_average
FROM bowler_runs br
JOIN bowler_wickets bw ON br.bowler = bw.bowler
JOIN player p ON br.bowler = p.player_id
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 10
```
